shots.say: Poppy's fur looks so white, like the snow. But is a polar bear really white?
Let's look very closely, at just one hair!
I'm Milo the bluebird. Let's find out together!
The Animated Zoo!
Polar bear fur has three big surprises. Let's find them, one by one!
Surprise number one! What color is one polar bear hair?
Is it white, like snow? Or clear, like water?
It is clear! Each hair is see-through. It has no color of its own.
Look through the hair. You can see the blue, right through it!
Make a magnifying glass with your fingers. Now look, look!
Both layers of fur are clear. The soft undercoat, and the long guard hairs!
Count the layers with me. One, two!
Wow! Poppy's hairs are not white at all. They are clear!
Poppy has lots and lots of hairs. And every one of them is clear!
Does a polar bear hair have a color of its own? Yes, or no?
No! No color at all. It is see-through.
Hold your hands up to your eyes, and peek through. Peekaboo!
Blink your eyes, like you are looking very closely. Blink, blink!
Say it with me. Polar bear hair is clear!
Quick check! Is one polar bear hair white, or clear?
Clear! See-through. Super job!
Surprise number two! If the hairs are clear, why does Poppy look white?
Is she painted white? Or is it the light?
It is the light! First, look inside a long hair. The middle is hollow. It is full of air!
Hollow, like a straw! Pretend to sip with a straw. Sip, sip!
When sunlight shines in, the light bounces all around. Count the sunbeams. One, two, three!
All that bouncing light makes the fur look white. Like sparkly ice!
Wiggle your fingers, like bouncing sunlight. Bounce, bounce!
Clear hairs, full of air, look white in the sun!
Is the middle of a long hair full, or hollow?
Hollow! The middle is full of air.
Puff your cheeks, full of air, like a hollow hair. Puff!
In the sunshine, look how white Poppy looks!
Clear hairs, but bright white fur. What a surprise!
Say it with me. The light makes polar bear fur look white!
Quick check! What is inside a long polar bear hair? Air, or water?
Air! Great job!
Surprise number three! What color is the skin, under Poppy's fur?
Is it pink? Or black?
Black! Under the clear fur, a polar bear has black skin.
And look at Poppy's nose. It is black too!
Can you touch your nose? Boop!
Sunlight shines through the clear fur, all the way down to the black skin.
The black skin soaks up the sun's warmth, and warms the bear!
Can the sunlight get through the clear fur, to the skin? Yes, or no?
Yes! Right through the clear fur.
Stretch up high, to the warm sun. Stretch!
Clear fur and black skin. Poppy is cozy in the sun!
Black skin, under clear fur. What a surprise!
Rub your hands together, in the warm sun. Warm, warm!
Sometimes the fur looks bright white. And in summer, it can look a little yellow!
Say it with me. Under the fur, a polar bear has black skin!
Quick check! What color is a polar bear's nose? Black, or orange?
Black! You remembered!
Three surprises! Now it is quiz time!
Is one polar bear hair white, or clear?
Clear! See-through hairs.
What makes the fur look white? The light, or paint?
The light! Bouncing all around.
What color is the skin, under the fur? Black, or pink?
Black skin! Warm in the sun.
Clear hairs, bouncing light, and black skin. You found all three surprises!
Make your magnifying glass, sip your straw, and boop your nose!
Clear fur, black skin, and a big warm smile. Bye-bye, friends!
The Animated Zoo!
